}}'''Luaine''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Maiden of the Spear]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Luaine}}

==Appearance==
Luaine is a young woman with yellow hair.{{ref/book|6|53}}

==Activities==
After [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], and [[Egwene al'Vere]] had been abducted by [[Adden]], [[Aviendha]] found Luaine and [[Dhael]] and rescued the women.{{ref/book|3|39}} Some time later, when [[Rand al'Thor]] was kidnapped by the [[White Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]], [[Sulin]] sends Luaine to find [[Nandera]] and [[Rhuarc]] so that they could help find him.{{ref/book|6|53}}
